findings.title: resolveClaudeModel exceeds function and file size limits
findings.problem: code-quality.md Code Structure Guidelines require functions under 50 lines and files under 500 lines. resolveClaudeModel spans lines 389-500 (~112 lines); this change added the keepWithContextWindow closure and further branches to an already long function, and the file now totals exactly 500 lines.
findings.impact: A documented code-quality standard is unmet by code this change grew, and it blocks the workflow; the function is also harder to reason about for future context-window changes.
findings.recommendation: Extract keepWithContextWindow and the catalog-ranking block into small module-level helpers so resolveClaudeModel drops under 50 lines and the file drops under 500.
